_comment: Time to first token (SPEC §8.2, §1: answers are read aloud, so TTFT is what a person actually experiences). Measured cold and warm: the system prompt and tool schemas are near-constant, so prefix caching is the main latency win (SPEC §2).
prefix: You are FarmHub, the assistant for a Norwegian homestead. Answer briefly and concretely; these answers are usually read aloud. Reply in the language the question was asked in. If you do not know something, say so plainly rather than guessing: a wrong part number or torque figure is worse than no answer.
prompts: Hvor kaldt blir det i natt?
What is the oil capacity of the tractor?
How long should the greenhouse be watered?
